# Rowan’s timeline

- **2019-09-07, move:** Rowan moved from the parents’ flat to a room above a bakery in Bellwick, with Kit bringing the books. [Rowan’s correction, 2026-11-06](../80_Sources/Interviews/2019-dates-correction.md#correction) quotes a calendar entry for this date and explicitly corrects the earlier late-August memory. The original interview and posts remain unchanged; see the [revision history](../90_Maintenance/Understanding%20updates.md#date-correction) and [story](../30_Stories/Chapters/The%20yellow%20mug%20on%20the%20windowsill.md).
- **2019-09-21, event and publication:** Kit returned with a folding table borrowed from their aunt; Rowan and Kit ate noodles, with Mum’s paper flowers in the yellow mug. The aunt’s winter return request was still an expectation. Source: [A table at last](../80_Sources/imports/7a8a469d4d19a731e24b37949ac5c8e813d46189c925f3544672361e599e6cbb-r1.md#^record-7a8a469d4d19a731e24b37949ac5c8e813d46189c925f3544672361e599e6cbb-r1).
- **2019-12-19, table handed back to Kit:** Rowan returned the borrowed table to Kit the day before a train trip. Kit then took it back to their aunt, on an unspecified date. Source: [Rowan’s correction, 2026-11-06](../80_Sources/Interviews/2019-dates-correction.md#correction). The January post’s shorter “in December” wording is preserved.
- **2020-01-12, room described and post published:** A small secondhand desk fitted beneath the window; faded paper flowers remained in the mug. The desk’s acquisition date is unknown. Source: [The window in winter](../80_Sources/imports/98764f41a20d7976640e3045e0d89f8691c7f47223239df66d7cc769c9c32754-r1.md#^record-98764f41a20d7976640e3045e0d89f8691c7f47223239df66d7cc769c9c32754-r1).
- **2026-11-06, recollection date:** Rowan described the move and first evening in a [saved interview](../80_Sources/Interviews/2019-first-move.md). This is the date of telling, not another occurrence of the move.
